description:
Perform Sholl analysis on a Drosophila neuron image to quantify dendritic branching complexity.

1. Open the neuron image at '~/Fiji_Data/raw/neuron/ddaC.tif'.
2. Preprocess the image (threshold to binary mask) to isolate the neuron structure.
3. Run 'Analyze > Sholl > Sholl Analysis'. You will need to identify the center of the soma (cell body) and place a point ROI there.
4. Configure the analysis:
   - Starting radius: 10 pixels
   - Step size: 10 pixels
   - Ending radius: Automatic or sufficient to cover the arbor
5. Save the resulting Intersection Counts table as '~/Fiji_Data/results/sholl/sholl_intersections.csv'.
6. Save the Sholl Profile plot (Intersections vs Radius) as '~/Fiji_Data/results/sholl/sholl_profile.png'.
7. Create a summary text file at '~/Fiji_Data/results/sholl/sholl_summary.txt' with the following metrics derived from your analysis:
   - max_intersections (peak count)
   - critical_radius (radius where peak occurs)
   - enclosing_radius (largest radius with intersections)
   - total_intersections (sum of all counts)
   Format: 'key=value' (one per line).
